programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: As Jerry settles in to watch a boxing match on TV, George and Elaine return with his borrowed car and concoct a wild story to explain why it's developed a clanking noise.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: When Kramer invites himself over once too often, Jerry demands he return the spare set of keys Jerry loaned to him, which virtually ends their open-door friendship. Distraught and overwrought, Kramer heads west to California.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: With Elaine in Europe, Jerry asks George to accompany him on a trip to LA and The Tonight Show, while there they will try to locate Kramer. Stars Jerry Seinfeld, Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Jason Alexander and Michael Richards.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry and George try to contact the police to tell them Kramer is innocent. Kramer still doesn't know he's a wanted man.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: NBC executives ask Jerry to come up with an idea for a TV series. George decides he can be a writer and comes up with a show about "nothing".

programme.title: Seinfeld

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry must be at his most creative when he has to explain to his visiting parents why he isn't wearing the watch they once gave him.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: A sweaty-palmed George tracks down a TV executive to negotiate his series deal - at a lower figure.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: Jerry agrees to make a side trip to visit a sickly fan, who must live in a protective plastic tent, while he and George drive up to a mountain cabin with their dates. But complications set in when Jerry gets lost while driving with Elaine.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: As George and Jerry start their script, George confronts Susan's father about the cabin fire.

programme.title: Seinfeld
programme.desc: A simple night turns into a nightmare when Jerry meets Elaine at the opera, unaware that her new boyfriend is "Crazy Joe Davola".

programme.title: Jamie's Best Ever Christmas
programme.desc: Jamie Oliver's favourite holiday dishes, from Boxing Day brunch to a flavourful jerk ham and creative turkey leftovers like pie and Christmas pudding strudel, are shared in this festive special.

programme.title: Rick Stein's Road To Mexico
programme.desc: Rick Stein's journey begins to draw to a close as he heads east from Oaxaca to the Yucatan Peninsula. It's here that they feast on the hottest chilli of them all, the habanero, and give slow food a new meaning.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's Next Level Chef
programme.desc: Ambitious cooks compete in a towering kitchen with three distinct levels, where access to ingredients and tools tests their creativity, skill and ability to adapt under pressure.

programme.title: Outback Gourmet With Justine Schofield
programme.desc: Today Justine travels from Darwin to Alice Springs. She joins Chef; Bob Taylor for a cultural tour of Sampson's Gap and later prepares a quick Spaghetti dish at ANZAC Hill.

programme.title: Left Off The Map
programme.desc: Holly visits Igor Van Gerwen, master chocolatier, who travels the world to discover & import the rarest cocoa to his chocolate factory in Tassie. Ben creates a delicious scallop & white wine spaghetti

programme.title: River Cottage Australia
programme.desc: Paul gets important advice on how to transform the farm's future. Digger is reunited with someone very special and Paul bravely takes his food truck for its first test run at the local farmers markets.

programme.title: Prue Leith's Cotswold Kitchen
programme.desc: Prue welcomes award-winning chef Tommy Banks as she makes two-tone soups and is joined in the kitchen by her husband John for a goat curd and tomato galette.

programme.title: High Country Farm

programme.title: The Collector
programme.desc: As the seconds tick down to midnight, an ex-con becomes a reluctant hero trapped by a masked "Collector" in a maze of lethal invention while trying to rescue the very family he came to rob.

programme.title: Amulet
programme.desc: An ex-soldier, living homeless in London, is offered a place to stay at a decaying house inhabited by a young woman and her dying mother. Falling for her, he cannot ignore his suspicion that something sinister is going on.

programme.title: Wrong Place
programme.desc: A meth producer tracks down a former police chief to silence him before he can testify, but soon finds himself facing more than he bargained for.

programme.title: District 13: Ultimatum
programme.desc: France. Explosive sequel set in the nightmare of a futuristic Paris. Corrupt cops conspire to launch a nuclear strike and take over a ghetto terrorised by marauding drug gangs and killers.

programme.title: The Man Who Killed Don Quixote
programme.desc: Toby, a cynical advertising director, finds himself trapped in the outrageous delusions of an old Spanish shoe-maker who believes himself to be Don Quixote.

programme.title: Dobermann
programme.desc: The Dobermann and his gang have been hitting the headlines. Banks, post-offices, bullion vans! The whole works! An anthology of robbery, a compilation of hold-ups!

programme.title: Oasis
programme.desc: An irresponsible and childish ex-con befriends a girl with cerebral palsy and develops a progressively stronger bond with her.

programme.title: To Catch A Killer: Part 2
programme.desc: Part 2. After achieving two search warrants, Kozenczak finds a large amount of incriminating evidence, and later 29 bodies buried throughout John Gacy's property.

programme.title: The Fall
programme.desc: In silent-era Hollywood, stuntman Roy Walker is taken to hospital after an on-set accident. He befriends a young girl and tells her a fantastical tale of heroes avenging an evil ruler.

programme.title: Corrective Measures
programme.desc: When a powerless new inmate arrives at a prison for supervillains, he must choose his friends wisely, or become a pawn in the deadly game between the Warden and the world's greatest criminal mastermind, The Lobe.

programme.title: Dogma
programme.desc: It's the film that's sparked controversy. Two fallen angels search for a way out of eternal exile in God-forsaken Wisconsin while a group of humans and supernaturals will stop them any way they can.

programme.title: Bride Of Re-Animator
programme.desc: A mad doctor and his accomplice return to the scene of a zombie massacre to continue their bodybuilding experiments.

programme.title: Suspiria
programme.desc: A girl enrols in an upmarket ballet academy, only to realise that the school is a front for something much more sinister and supernatural.

programme.title: I Spit On Your Grave
programme.desc: An aspiring writer is repeatedly sexually abused, humiliated, and left for dead by four men whom she systematically hunts down to seek revenge, inflicting upon them every horrifying and torturous moment they carried out on her.

programme.title: Top Knot Detective
programme.desc: Takashi Takamoto begins writing jingles for a well-known Japanese company and ends up creating a bloody series of samurai action that, over time, becomes a cult series.

programme.title: Relaxer
programme.desc: With the impending Y2K apocalypse fast approaching, Abbie is faced with the ultimate challenge - the unbeatable level 256 on Pac-Man - and he can't get off the couch until he conquers it.

programme.title: The House That Jack Built
programme.desc: USA in the 1970s. We follow the highly intelligent Jack over a span of 12 years and are introduced to the murders that define his development as a serial killer.

programme.title: Police Story
programme.desc: A kung-fu policeman (Jackie Chan) must protect a female witness (Brigitte Lin) from a Hong Kong drug lord for whom she used to work.

programme.title: Vivarium
programme.desc: A young couple looking for the perfect home find themselves trapped in a mysterious labyrinth-like neighbourhood of identical houses.

programme.title: Wasabi
programme.desc: The death of a ex-lover puts a French cop on a collision course with the Yakuza and the daughter he never knew he had.

programme.title: The Crying Game
programme.desc: An unconventional and unpredictable story follows members of an armed group, their hostage, and a mysterious relationship that unfolds in unexpected ways, mixing tension, emotion, and surprising twists.

programme.title: The Endless
programme.desc: Two brothers return to the UFO cult they fled to discover that the group's beliefs may be more sane than they once thought.

programme.title: Memento
programme.desc: A story told both forwards and backwards in time about an ex- insurance investigator, unable to remember new thoughts, who uses notes and tattoos to hunt for the man he thinks killed his wife.

programme.title: The Last Stop In Yuma County
programme.desc: Stranded at an Arizona rest stop, a travelling knife salesman gets thrust into a high-stakes hostage situation by the arrival of two bank robbers who will stop at nothing to protect their ill-begotten fortune.

programme.title: Noroi: The Curse
programme.desc: A paranormal journalist named Kobayashi goes missing shortly after completing a documentary. What begins as an investigation into strange noises soon evolves into the chilling mystery of a demonic entity.

programme.title: Hellraiser (1987)
programme.desc: A man opens a mysterious puzzle box and is taken to a hellish realm. After escaping and returning to his family home, he needs human blood to restore himself, forming a dangerous alliance with a family member.

programme.title: Hell House LLC
programme.desc: Five years after 15 people were killed during a haunted house tour, a documentary crew visits the scene to investigate what really happened.

programme.title: Prisoners Of The Ghostland
programme.desc: In the treacherous frontier city of Samurai Town, a notorious criminal must break an evil curse in order to rescue an abducted girl who has mysteriously disappeared.

programme.title: Come To Daddy
programme.desc: Norval, a privileged man-child travels to the beautiful and remote cabin of his estranged father, in order to reconnect with him as he hasn't seen him in 30 years.

programme.title: G.I. Samurai
programme.desc: A squadron of Japanese Self-Defence Force soldiers find themselves transported through time to their country's warring states era, when rival samurai clans were battling to become the supreme Shogun.

programme.title: The Stunt Man
programme.desc: A fugitive stumbles onto a movie set just when they need a new stunt man, takes the job as a way to hide out and falls for the leading lady while facing off with his manipulative director.

programme.title: Heathers
programme.desc: Veronica meets a James Dean-type newcomer who suggests they kill off the popular kids and end cruel, unfair treatment the girls impose on unpopular kids at school.

programme.title: Arctic
programme.desc: Sole-survivor of a plane crash, and stranded deep within the Arctic Circle, Overgard is waiting to be rescued, when a sudden turn of events finds him no longer on his own.

programme.title: A Bittersweet Life
programme.desc: In this neo-noir thriller, a gangster assigned to spy on his bosss mistress finds himself in danger after sparing her and her secret lover. Tensions rise as loyalty, betrayal, and survival collide.

programme.title: The Toxic Avenger
programme.desc: In Tromaville, the toxic waste capital of America, a bullied janitor in a popular gym falls into a vat of toxic waste. He then turns into a super strong disfigured man.

programme.title: Eaten Alive
programme.desc: Psychotic redneck Judd owns a dilapidated hotel in rural Texas, where he murders people and then feeds their remains to his large pet crocodile in the swamp beside his hotel.

programme.title: The Wrestler
programme.desc: A washed-up wrestler is forced to retire after a heart attack. His quest for a normal life is an unrelenting struggle.

programme.title: Sator
programme.desc: Secluded in a desolate forest, a broken family is observed by the demon Sator who is attempting to claim them.

programme.title: Hellbound: Hellraiser II
programme.desc: Kristy Cotton is in a psychiatric hospital reliving the hellish events pertaining to a certain puzzle box that contains deadly spirits.

programme.title: Hell House LLC II: The Abbadon Hotel
programme.desc: Eight years after a hotel's tragic opening, an investigative journalist is convinced key evidence remains in the abandoned hotel.

programme.title: Puppet Master 3: Toulons Revenge
programme.desc: Gestapo agents face killer dolls when they murder puppeteer Toulon's wife in this prequel to "Puppet Master".

programme.title: Project Wolf Hunting
programme.desc: (South Korea) When dangerous criminals on a cargo ship are transported from the Phillipines to South Korea, they unleash a sinister force after an escape attempt leads to a riot. (Subtitles)

programme.title: The Hit
programme.desc: A hit man is sent to Spain to kidnap an ex-criminal and transport him to Paris for execution.

programme.title: Coming Home In The Dark
programme.desc: A school teacher is forced to confront a brutal act from his past when a pair of ruthless drifters takes him and his family on a nightmare road-trip.

programme.title: You Don't Nomi: Verhoeven's Showgirls
programme.desc: Trace Paul Verhoeven's Showgirls (1995) redemptive journey from notorious flop to cult classic, and maybe even masterpiece.

programme.title: The Hitcher
programme.desc: A young man who escapes the clutches of a murderous hitchhiker is subsequently stalked by the hitcher and framed for his crimes.

programme.title: You Were Never Really Here
programme.desc: Joe (Joaquin Phoenix) is a hired gun who rescues trafficked girls, using brutal methods against those responsible.

programme.title: Pulse
programme.desc: An employee of a floral shop hangs himself when a colleague goes to his apartment to investigate his absence from work.

programme.title: Dark Water
programme.desc: A mother going through a divorce moves into a run down apartment with her daughter. Visions of a missing girl, and other eerie phenomena become increasingly menacing.

programme.title: Severance
programme.desc: A bonding weekend goes horribly wrong for seven colleagues who find themselves facing the chop when they are sabotaged by a deadly enemy. Only the smartest will survive this brutal office outing.

programme.title: Marmalade
programme.desc: Baron strikes up a friendship with his new cellmate, a man with a history of prison breaks. As they hatch a plan to escape, Baron recalls how he met the love of his life.

programme.title: The Autopsy Of Jane Doe
programme.desc: A father and son, both coroners, are pulled into a complex mystery while attempting to identify the body of a young woman.

programme.title: Hellraiser III: Hell On Earth
programme.desc: J.P., a womanising nightclub owner, buys a bizarre, abstract pillar at a mysterious art gallery. Unknowingly, he's purchased the gateway to hell.

programme.title: Hell House LLC III: Lake Of Fire
programme.desc: The Abaddon Hotel will once again be open to the public. Russell Wynn has taken his audience-interactive show, Insomnia, into the abandoned hotel that is rumored to be haunted.

programme.title: Howling VI: The Freaks
programme.desc: A villainous carnival owner traps a young werewolf to include in his growing menagerie of inhuman exhibits.

programme.title: Hokuriku Proxy War
programme.desc: A Yakuza group from Osaka with dreams of national dominance moves into the snowy Hokuriku region, sparking a bloody turf war with local gangs.

programme.title: Joint Security Area
programme.desc: After a shooting incident at the North-South Korean border DMZ leaves two North Korean soldiers dead, a neutral Swiss and Swedish team investigates what actually happened.

programme.title: Timecrimes
programme.desc: A man accidentally gets into a time machine and travels back in time nearly an hour. Finding himself will be the first of a series of disasters of unforeseeable consequences.

programme.title: Pusher 2
programme.desc: In part two of Danish director Nicolas Winding Refn's crime trilogy, Mads Mikkelsen plays Tonny, a criminal at the mercy of his cold-hearted gangster father.

programme.title: Cypher
programme.desc: A suburban dwelling man looking for some change and excitement becomes a corporate spy, but after meeting a mysterious woman he begins to question everything.

programme.title: Naked Weapon
programme.desc: A group of girls are kidnapped and trained to become assassins for a criminal organisation, ruled over by the ruthless Madam M.

programme.title: Fist of Fury
programme.desc: During the Japanese occupation of Shanghai, the star pupil of a recently-deceased martial arts teacher battles a Japanese dojo which seeks the demise of his master's fighting school.

programme.title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles (1990)
programme.desc: From their base in the city sewers, turtle heroes Michelangelo, Raphael, Leonardo and Donatello are on a mission to defeat an evil warlord and wipe out crime.

programme.title: Barb Wire
programme.desc: The Baywatch babe squeezes into a black leather outfit to become Barb Wire, a bar owner/mercenary, persuaded to help her former lover in the fight against the fascist dictatorship in USA 2017.

programme.title: Beverly Hills Cop
